entities.name: René Schick
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Schick Gutiérrez was a Nicaraguan politician, lawyer, and diplomat who served as the President of Nicaragua from 1963 until his death in 1966. He was previously the Minister of Foreign Affairs under President Luis Somoza Debayle from 1961 to 1962 and as well as the Minister of Education from 1957 to 1962.
